summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of material event regarding the payment of the second installment of cash dividends for fiscal year 2025, as approved at the ordinary shareholders' meeting on April 28, 2026. The dividend amount is Ps. 13,333,257,333.33, payable to shareholders of record as of August 3, 2026, with an effective date of August 6, 2026. This is a routine dividend distribution, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or capital return event. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16.
